title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-16

ai_review.summary: Audience tape captures a high‑energy jam with a standout Scarlet > Fire, but the audio is muddy and bass‑hard to hear.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its hot jamming and a memorable Scarlet > Fire sequence, with some listeners noting sweet keyboard work on "Friend of the Devil." Recording quality is mixed – one reviewer calls it a great audience capture while another describes the sound as terrible, especially the buried bass guitar.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is generally good (high energy, standout songs) but recording quality ranges from decent to poor, pulling the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as muddy with bass guitar difficult to isolate; occasional drum bass audible. One reviewer praises the immersive audience feel, while another calls the sound terrible.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong jam sections with a highlighted second‑night sequence; overall flow feels lively despite some mixed feelings about the show overall.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard work on 'Friend of the Devil' was noted as sweet.
